authorization_status.old: Pending independent code/plan review and root approval; creation of this file authorizes no trajectory
authorization_status.new: No trajectories; pending independently reviewed repair seal and exact new root authorization

new.method: analytic branch-aware circuit and exact zero-ledger columns; bounded magnetic q-only differences
new.kink_convention: inactive branch at abs(Vp)==Vs; current law unchanged

explicit_unchanged.damping_provenance: Inherited uncalibrated development assumption from source world; c=2*zeta*sqrt(m*k), not inferred from ceramic Qm

rectifier.type: ideal full-wave bridge plus fixed series resistor and otherwise ideal storage capacitor
rectifier.choice: Explicit round-number passive benchmark assumption selected before trajectories, not measured ESR and not a fitted/optimized/native diode or PMIC model
rectifier.law: I=max(abs(Vp)-Vs,0)/R; terminal outward i=sign(Vp)*I; Qdot=-i; Cin*Vsdot=I
rectifier.power_identity: Vp*i = Vs*I + R*I^2 >=0 for Vs>=0; ideal diode loss=0

explicit_unchanged.initial_recipe: Same retained stable closed-door root for all four trajectories, selected by STATIC-PREFLIGHT-PLAN; Q0=theta*q0 makes physical Vpiezo=0; signed electrode charge is not an electrical precharge
explicit_unchanged.initial_preparation: Computational initial equilibrium only; initial elastic and signed mutual potential are accounted; preparation/reset work remains unknown and no first-operation/reset qualification is claimed

driver_input.break_handling: two continuous-state integration segments meet exactly at 2s; one-sided driver powers retained

ledger.work_scope: Work by externally prescribed driver against magnetic forces and torque only; driver-mechanism inertia, actuation friction and reset are outside boundary
ledger.normalization: max(initial nonmagnetic positive storage,abs(Wdriver),abs(Umag(t)-Umag(0)),1e-9 J); invariant to magnetic additive constant

mechanical_assumptions: One retained Ritz bending coordinate with fixed mass/stiffness/reciprocal piezo port
Magnetic COM path and pitch are q-only short-circuit kinematics; nonzero-voltage axial shift beta*V and force-induced additional axial shift are omitted
Discarded bending shapes and torque-driven modal content, axial inertia, geometric/material nonlinearity, actual tensor, damping, losses, assembly and installation physics are unqualified
Voltage/domain guards are computational only. No negligibility or physical-accuracy bound on omitted coordinates is claimed

gates.continuous_numerical_path: Radau cubic q extrema exactly evaluated. Magnet clearance at interval start minus h*(maximum tip translation/rotation speed + driver translation/rotation speed) must remain >1e-12m. This bounds separation along numerical cubic, not exact ODE path or surrounding assembly.
